**Para o Daniel:** Esta página tem **todas as respostas em inglês** para copiar nos formulários. Use junto com . **Não clique em Submit** — mover para **Em revisão** e avisar o Paulo. --- ## Quick copy — personal info
FieldAnswer (English)
Legal full namePaulo Eduardo Gonçalves de Freitas
Preferred namePaulo Freitas
Emailhello@dudesign.us
PhoneLeave blank if optional. If **required**, ask Paulo on WhatsApp first.
CountryBrazil
City / AddressBrazil (remote). Do not invent a US city. Use **Remote — Brazil** or **Brazil**.
Time zoneUTC-3 (Brasília)
Desired titleProduct Designer — AI/SaaS
Years of experience8+ years
Current companyDUDESIGN
Current titleFounder / Product Designer
Start dateImmediate / flexible
RelocationYes — open to relocate at any time
Salary expectation$200,000 USD/year
LanguagesPortuguese (native) · English (professional) · French (studying)
--- ## Work authorization & location
QuestionAnswer
Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?**No**
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?**Yes**
Are you authorized to work in your country of residence?**Yes** (Brazil)
Are you open to working remotely?**Yes** — fully remote preferred
Are you willing to relocate?**Yes** — open to relocate at any time
Do you need visa sponsorship for US employment?**Yes**
Are you located in the US?**No** — Brazil
Can you work US business hours?**Yes** — flexible overlap with US time zones
Paulo is in **Brazil**, targeting **remote US** roles. Answer honestly — never mark "authorized to work in US" as Yes. --- ## Links (use on EVERY application)
ItemURL
Portfoliohttps://paulo.dudesign.us
Resume (print to PDF)https://paulo.dudesign.us/resume → Ctrl+P → Save as PDF
LinkedInhttps://www.linkedin.com/in/freitas-pauloo
GitHubhttps://github.com/freitaspauloo
Behancehttps://www.behance.net/freitaspaulo
Xhttps://x.com/freitaspauloo
Use **paulo.dudesign.us** — never dudesign.us (that's the client deck). **Case studies:** - Aligned AI → https://paulo.dudesign.us/work/aligned-ai - Frameline → https://paulo.dudesign.us/work/frameline - BuiltOps / Losani → https://paulo.dudesign.us/work/builtops --- ## Education
FieldAnswer
DegreeNo formal design degree. 8+ years professional product design experience.
If field is requiredSelect **Other** or **Prefer not to say**. Free text: *Professional experience in product design (8+ years). Fortune 500 clients: Audi, Samsung, 3M, Ford, Sony+Honda, Costco.*
School / UniversitySelf-taught + professional experience. Use **Other** if dropdown required.
--- ## Employment history
PeriodCompanyTitleDescription
2020–presentDUDESIGNFounder / Product DesignerProduct design partner for AI startups. UX/UI and shipped interfaces in code.
2024–2025XIX3DSenior Product DesignerProduct design, HMI, brand systems. Clients: Audi, Samsung, 3M, Ford, Sony+Honda, Costco.
2023SMPL - MKT & ConsultingVisual DesignerSocial media and visual design.
**Earlier career (only if long-form "tell us about yourself"):** Print shop designer → social media at marketing agency → junior designer for Canadian partner → mid-level at XIX3D (automotive/3D SaaS) → independent practice (DUDESIGN). --- ## Skills & tools — check Yes when asked **Core skills:** Cross-functional leadership · AI & agent UX · Prototyping in code · B2B SaaS & enterprise · Design systems · Trust & accessibility UX · Interaction & visual craft · End-to-end product design **Tools:** Figma · Cursor · React · Next.js · v0 · Claude · GitHub · Notion **Always mark Yes:** AI products · Prototyping in code · Design systems · Cross-functional PM+Eng · B2B/enterprise · Cursor/AI coding tools · Figma --- ## Common questions — short answers
QuestionAnswer
Gender / ethnicity / veteran / disability (EEO)Decline to self-identify / Prefer not to say
How did you hear about this job?LinkedIn / Company website / Job board
ReferencesAvailable upon request
Currently employed?Yes — Founder, DUDESIGN (self-employed)
Why are you leaving your current role?Looking for an IC product designer seat on a product team — go deep on one product with a strong cross-functional team.
Notice periodFlexible / immediate for the right role
Are you open to contract / full-time?Full-time preferred
Portfolio password?No password — public at paulo.dudesign.us
Have you applied here before?No (unless Paulo says otherwise)
Do you have a non-compete?No
LinkedIn URLhttps://www.linkedin.com/in/freitas-pauloo
Website / portfolio URLhttps://paulo.dudesign.us
GitHub URLhttps://github.com/freitaspauloo
Do you have experience with AI products?Yes — Aligned AI workspace, Frameline (AI-era surfaces), agent UX patterns
Do you prototype in code?Yes — daily with Cursor, React, Next.js. Portfolio and Frameline are shipped in code.
Do you have design systems experience?Yes — Fortune 500 brand systems at XIX3D + component libraries in Frameline and client work
Do you have B2B / enterprise experience?Yes — BuiltOps/Losani CMS platform, Aligned B2B AI workspace, Fortune 500 enterprise clients
Do you have dev tools experience?Yes — Frameline (installable React surfaces), portfolio built on Next.js/Vercel stack
Management experience?Led design on projects; no formal people-management title. Applying for IC roles.
What's your design process?Start with the business problem → map flows → prototype in Figma and code → ship production UI → iterate with PM and Eng
What's your biggest strength?Shipping in code — I don't stop at mocks. Fortune 500 craft at startup speed.
What's a weakness?Formal user research process — I validate through prototypes and stakeholder feedback; learning to instrument usability earlier.
Why product design?I like deciding what to build, not just how it looks. Product judgment + UX/UI + shipped interface.
Preferred team size?Small to mid-size product team with strong PM and Eng partners
Work authorization in Canada?No — would require sponsorship (same as US)
Work authorization in UK/EU?No — would require sponsorship
--- ## Long-form text — copy & adapt
Summary / About (2–3 sentences) Product designer with Fortune 500 craft (Audi, Samsung, 3M, Ford, Sony + Honda, Costco) and startup ship speed. I design complex AI/SaaS surfaces and implement production UI in code. Portfolio: https://paulo.dudesign.us
Cover letter — generic I'm a product designer who ships in code — not just mocks. I've built AI workspace UX (Aligned), a design-engineering surface library (Frameline), and enterprise CMS platforms (BuiltOps). I'm looking for an IC seat on a product team where I can go deep on one product with strong PM and Eng partners. Portfolio: https://paulo.dudesign.us
Why are you interested in this role? This role matches how I work: complex product surfaces, high craft bar, and shipping in code. I've designed AI and B2B workflows (Aligned, BuiltOps) and I'm drawn to teams that expect designers to prototype beyond Figma. I'd love to contribute product judgment and production UI on your team.
Why are you interested in this company? (template — adapt 1 sentence) [Company] sits at the intersection of [AI/SaaS/dev tools] and [high-stakes user workflows] — where trust UX and craft matter. I've designed complex B2B and AI products (Aligned, BuiltOps, Frameline) and I'm drawn to [Company]'s bar for interaction design and ship speed.
Tell us about a project you're proud of **Frameline** — I built a design-engineering surface library from zero: product definition, visual language, configurator UX, and full-stack implementation. The problem: teams ship AI products that all look the same. The solution: installable typed React components, not PNG handoffs. Live at frameline.ai. This is proof I can take a surface from design to production code solo.
Describe your experience with AI products I've designed AI workspace UX for Aligned (trust patterns, benchmark content IA, production UI), built Frameline (surfaces for the AI era — installable components), and worked on agent UX patterns including provenance, human-in-the-loop states, and explainability. I prototype daily with Cursor and Claude.
Describe your experience prototyping in code I build production UI in React/Next.js using Cursor daily. My portfolio (paulo.dudesign.us) is Next.js. Frameline is a full-stack product I designed and built. For client work I ship components and pages in code, not Figma handoffs. Comfortable with HTML/CSS, React components, and working near engineering.
Describe cross-functional work with PM and Eng At XIX3D I partnered with PM and engineering on HMI and product design for Fortune 500 clients. At DUDESIGN I run weekly updates, decision logs, and stakeholder walkthroughs with founders and eng partners. I start with the business problem, align on success metrics with PM, and prototype with Eng early so we validate feel, not just pixels.
What are you looking for in your next role? An IC product designer seat on a product team — go deep on one product with strong cross-functional partners. I want mature product process, complex systems to design for, and a team that values shipping in code. Remote US preferred; open to relocation.
Additional information / anything else? Portfolio with case studies: https://paulo.dudesign.us — includes Aligned AI, Frameline, and BuiltOps/Losani. Open to discussing visa sponsorship for the right role.
--- ## Company-specific — "Why this company?"
Harvey Harvey sits at AI + high-stakes professional work — where trust UX matters. I've designed complex B2B and AI workflows (Aligned, BuiltOps) and I'm drawn to Harvey's bar for interaction craft in legal AI.
Owner.com Owner.com is AI SaaS at startup speed with real product complexity — matches how I work. Fortune 500 craft applied to a fast-moving AI product team.
GitLab GitLab's AI dev tools match how I work: prototype in Cursor, ship in React. Remote-first, code-adjacent product design on a platform developers trust.
Render Render is an AI-native dev cloud. I design for developers and ship in code daily — Frameline is proof of design-engineering at product scale.
Vercel Vercel is v0, Next.js, and growth on a dev-first product. I build on this stack daily — paulo.dudesign.us is Next.js + Cursor.
Linear Linear sets the craft bar for product tools in the AI era. I care about interaction detail and ship speed — exactly what Linear stands for.
Notion Notion is the AI workspace category done right — timeless product design with AI layered in thoughtfully. I've designed workspace UX (Aligned) and use Notion daily.
Stripe Stripe is systems thinking at scale — complex B2B, trust UX, and data-heavy products. My enterprise work (BuiltOps, Fortune 500) maps to Stripe's bar.
Anthropic Anthropic's enterprise and core apps need trust-first AI UX — provenance, safety, clarity. I've designed trust patterns for AI products and prototype in code daily.
Scale AI Scale sits at enterprise AI data — complex B2B with high stakes. My Fortune 500 and AI workspace experience maps to designing for technical, enterprise users.
--- ## When to STOP and ask Paulo - Phone number is **required** - Salary listed below **$140k** - Legal signature / background check / ID upload - Question not covered on this page - Role is **Design Engineer** or **Manager** (Paulo wants **IC Product Designer**) - Form asks to confirm US work authorization as Yes --- ## Logins & accounts See . - Applications email: **hello@dudesign.us** - LinkedIn Easy Apply: hello@dudesign.us - Greenhouse/Ashby: create account with hello@dudesign.us - Resume PDF: paulo.dudesign.us/resume → Ctrl+P → Save as **Paulo-Freitas-Resume.pdf**
